Technical_Implementation_Notes: Information security policy suite approved by board and published on intranet; reviewed annually and after significant incidents.
Notes: Policy must reference all relevant Annex A domains; version control and board sign-off evidence required.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: RACI matrix defined for all information security roles; responsibilities documented in job descriptions and the ISMS manual.
Notes: Ensure roles are mapped to named individuals and deputies are designated for key positions.

Control_Name: Inventory of information and other associated assets
Technical_Implementation_Notes: Asset register maintained in ServiceNow CMDB covering hardware, software, data assets, and cloud services; reviewed quarterly.
Notes: Cloud assets (Azure subscriptions and M365 tenants) must be included; data classification must be recorded per asset.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Conditional Access policies enforce least-privilege access across Entra ID; Azure RBAC assignments reviewed quarterly; PIM active for all privileged roles.
Notes: Verify no Conditional Access policies remain in Report-only mode; confirm PIM is active for Owner and Contributor roles.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Joiner-mover-leaver process enforced via Entra ID Lifecycle Workflows; guest account reviews run quarterly; stale account report reviewed monthly.
Notes: Entra ID HR inbound provisioning integration with HR system to be validated; confirm Lifecycle Workflow audit logs are retained.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Entra ID Password Protection deployed; banned password list configured; SSPR enabled with two-method verification; service principal secrets tracked in secrets register.
Notes: Confirm Password Protection is enforced on-premises via the Entra ID Password Protection agent on domain controllers.

Control_Name: Information security for use of cloud services
Technical_Implementation_Notes: Cloud security policy and shared responsibility matrix documented for Azure and M365; supplier risk assessments completed for all critical SaaS providers.
Notes: Annual review of Microsoft Service Trust Portal compliance documentation required; include in supplier review schedule.

Control_Name: Information security incident management planning and preparation
Technical_Implementation_Notes: Incident response plan documented and tested via tabletop exercise annually; playbooks defined for ransomware, data breach, and account compromise scenarios.
Notes: Confirm playbooks are accessible offline in the event of a ransomware incident that disables IT systems.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Pre-employment screening policy requires criminal record check and employment history verification for all staff; enhanced screening for roles with privileged access.
Notes: Contractor and third-party screening requirements must be included; evidence of completion is held in HR system.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Information security responsibilities included in employment contracts and contractor agreements; signed acknowledgement on file for all staff.
Notes: Review contractor agreement templates to ensure data handling obligations align with current ISMS policy.

Control_Name: Information security awareness education and training
Technical_Implementation_Notes: Annual mandatory information security awareness training delivered via KnowBe4; phishing simulation campaigns run quarterly; completion reports retained.
Notes: Minimum 95% completion rate required before surveillance audit; remedial training assigned to non-completers within 14 days.

Control_Name: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
Technical_Implementation_Notes: Leaver process documented; IT access revoked within four hours of confirmed departure; asset return checklist completed; NDA obligations communicated at exit interview.
Notes: Spot-check leaver evidence against AD/Entra ID account disable timestamps to verify SLA compliance.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: PIM enabled for all Entra ID and Azure privileged roles; permanent Global Administrator assignments limited to break-glass accounts; privileged role reviews run quarterly.
Notes: Confirm that PIM activation requires MFA and manager approval for all roles at Tier 0 scope.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: MFA enforced for all users and admins via Conditional Access; legacy authentication blocked; Entra ID Identity Protection risk policies active; FIDO2 keys deployed for Tier 0 admins.
Evidence_Type: MFA registration report / CA policy export
Notes: Target 100% MFA registration; follow up on any per-user MFA 'Enabled' (not Enforced) states remaining from legacy configuration.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint deployed on all endpoints and servers; Safe Attachments and Safe Links active in M365; ASR rules in Block mode; signature currency monitored via MDE dashboard.
Evidence_Type: MDE onboarding report / EOP policy export
Notes: Confirm ASR rules are in Block (not Audit) mode; validate exclusions register is current and approved.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Azure Policy and Intune compliance policies enforce baseline configurations; CIS benchmark applied to Windows endpoints via Intune; configuration drift detected via Defender for Cloud.
Evidence_Type: Azure Policy compliance report / Intune compliance export
Notes: Review Azure Policy non-compliant resources monthly; assign remediation tasks with defined owners and due dates.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Microsoft Purview DLP policies deployed covering Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive; policies target sensitive information types including financial data, PII, and health information.
Notes: Review DLP incident queue monthly; confirm policies are in Enforce (not Test) mode for all sensitive information types in scope.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Unified Audit Log enabled in M365; Azure Diagnostic Settings routing logs to Log Analytics Workspace; Microsoft Sentinel ingesting M365 and Azure logs; on-premises WEF forwarding to SIEM.
Evidence_Type: UAL config export / Sentinel connector screenshot
Notes: Confirm log retention meets minimum 90-day online and 12-month total requirement; validate Sentinel alert rules are active and assigned.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Microsoft Sentinel analytic rules active for high-risk events; Defender XDR incidents reviewed daily by SOC; monthly threat hunting exercises documented; anomalous sign-in alerts configured.
Evidence_Type: Sentinel alert rule export / SOC review log
Notes: Evidence must show alert review process is operational; suppressed or paused alert rules are a significant audit finding.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Azure NSGs applied to all subnets; Azure Firewall deployed at hub; on-premises perimeter firewall with documented ruleset; network segmentation diagram current and reviewed annually.
Notes: Annual firewall ruleset review required; ensure legacy any/any rules are removed and all rules have documented business justification.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Azure Key Vault used for key management; TLS 1.2 minimum enforced on all Azure App Services and API endpoints; M365 data encrypted at rest using Microsoft-managed keys; BYOK evaluated for sensitive workloads.
Evidence_Type: Key Vault audit log / TLS configuration export
Notes: Document cryptographic algorithm standards in the cryptography policy; review annually against NCSC and NIST guidance.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Secure development lifecycle policy documented; SAST tooling (GitHub Advanced Security / Defender for DevOps) integrated into CI/CD pipelines; dependency scanning enabled; code review mandatory before merge.
Notes: Confirm SAST findings are tracked to closure; establish SLA for critical vulnerability remediation in code before deployment.

Technical_Implementation_Notes: Change management procedure documented and operating via ServiceNow; all changes to production systems require CAB approval; emergency change process defined with post-implementation review.
Notes: Sample 10 changes per audit period for evidence review; confirm emergency changes have retrospective CAB approval documented.
